features.name: x_mark_fraction
features.description: Fraction of the 9 squares containing x.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a normalized x occupancy measure so a linear SVM can weight material density smoothly.
features.formula: (np.where(top_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(top_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'x', 1, 0)) / 9.0

features.name: o_mark_fraction
features.description: Fraction of the 9 squares containing o.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a normalized o occupancy measure so a linear SVM can weight opposing material density smoothly.
features.formula: (np.where(top_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(top_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'o', 1, 0)) / 9.0

features.name: blank_square_fraction
features.description: Fraction of the 9 squares containing b, representing remaining board space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures game-stage progression with a smooth scalar useful for margin scaling.
features.formula: (np.where(top_left_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(top_middle_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_middle_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'b', 1, 0)) / 9.0

features.name: center_occupancy_signed
features.description: Signed center occupancy: 1 for x, -1 for o, 0 for b.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the high-leverage center position as one ordered coordinate for a linear SVM.

features.name: corner_occupancy_balance
features.description: Signed balance of corner occupancy, scaled by the 4 corners; x contributes 1, o contributes -1, and b contributes 0 before scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes corner influence in a normalized linear-friendly projection.
features.formula: ((np.where(top_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'x', 1, 0)) - (np.where(top_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'o', 1, 0))) / 4.0

features.name: edge_occupancy_balance
features.description: Signed balance of edge-square occupancy, scaled by the 4 non-corner non-center squares.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates edge-heavy patterns from corner and center patterns without requiring multiple raw indicators.
features.formula: ((np.where(top_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'x', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'x', 1, 0)) - (np.where(top_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'o', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'o', 1, 0))) / 4.0

features.name: x_strategic_coherence_score
features.description: Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how coherently x marks work together: 0.0 for isolated or easily blocked placements, 1.0 for center/corner support with mutually reinforcing open lines and fork potential visible in the board.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses nonlinear x coordination into a smooth numeric input that a linear SVM can weight directly.

features.name: o_disruption_resilience_score
features.description: Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how effectively o placements disrupt x alignments while preserving o line opportunities: 0.0 for little disruption, 1.0 for strong blocking plus counter-threat structure visible in the board.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth opponent-pressure coordinate for boards with similar counts but different tactical structure.
